design.fix_plan: Enable Windows App SDK self-contained deployment, initialize logging synchronously before window construction, add pre/post-main-window startup logs, and avoid catch-and-continue handling for native fail-fast.
design.root_cause: KeyboardManagerEditorUI omitted WindowsAppSDKSelfContained=true, allowing machine-wide and app-local Windows App SDK payloads to mix and causing startup fail-fast during title-bar/input initialization.
repro: Open Keyboard Manager Editor from Settings
Observe that the editor silently fails to launch
verify: Compare app-local WinRT manifests and bootstrap references
Test Store installs on Windows 10 and Windows 11
Confirm startup logs before and after main-window construction
